serverInfo.name: sap.s4/warehouse-availablestock-0001-mcp
serverInfo.title: SAP S4 Warehouse Available Stock MCP
serverInfo.description: MCP server for the Warehouse Available Stock (A2X) service.

tools.name: get_metadata_whse_stock
tools.title: get_metadata_whse_stock
tools.description: Get metadata of the Warehouse Available Stock OData service. Returns metadata in XML format to discover available entities and their properties.

tools.name: list_warehouseavailablestock
tools.title: list_WarehouseAvailableStock
tools.description: Retrieve a list of warehouse available stock records. Filter by Product, EWMWarehouse, or other properties to check inventory availability (AvailableEWMStockQty) for at-risk order diagnosis. Supports OData query options: $filter, $select, $top, $skip, $orderby.

tools.name: get_warehouseavailablestock
tools.title: get_WarehouseAvailableStock
tools.description: Retrieve a single warehouse available stock record by its composite key (EWMWarehouse, Product, Batch, etc.).
